meta.name: hugging-science
meta.description: Use when the user is doing AI/ML work in a scientific domain such as biology, chemistry, physics, astronomy, climate, genomics, materials, medicine, ecology, energy, engineering, math, drug discovery, protein design, weather modeling, theorem proving, single-cell, or PDE solving. Hugging Science is a curated catalog of scientific datasets, models, blog posts, and interactive Spaces. This skill helps discover and use resources via `datasets`, `transformers`, the HF Inference API, `gradio_client`, and methodology citations.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 发现并使用科学领域的AI模型与数据集
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果正在做生物、化学、物理等科学领域的AI/ML工作
copy.tagline_en: Discover and use AI models and datasets for scientific domains
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you are doing AI/ML work in biology, chemistry, physics, or other scientific fields

howto.what: 装上后，Claude能在你处理科学领域AI/ML任务时，从Hugging Science精选目录中查找并推荐适合的科学数据集、模型、博客和交互演示，并指导你用Hugging Face标准API加载使用。
howto.when: 当你提到AI/ML应用于科学领域（如生物、化学、物理等），或询问某个科学问题是否有现成数据集或模型，或需要微调、评估、复现科学ML论文时触发。

say.text: 我想找蛋白质结构预测用的数据集和模型。
say.note: Claude会从目录中检索相关资源并推荐。

say.text: 有没有适合分子性质预测的预训练模型？
say.note: Claude会筛选化学领域模型并给出使用方法。

say.text: 帮我用BoltzGen设计一个蛋白质结合剂。

howto.what_en: When active, Claude can discover and recommend scientific datasets, models, blog posts, and interactive demos from the Hugging Science curated catalog, then guide you to use them via standard Hugging Face APIs like datasets, transformers, Inference API, and gradio_client.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you mention AI/ML for scientific domains (biology, chemistry, physics, etc.), ask for a dataset/model for a scientific problem, or need to fine-tune, evaluate, or reproduce a scientific ML paper.

say_en.text: I need datasets and models for protein structure prediction.
say_en.note: Claude will search the catalog and recommend relevant resources.

say_en.text: Any pretrained model for molecular property prediction?
say_en.note: Claude will filter chemistry models and show how to use them.

say_en.text: Help me design a protein binder with BoltzGen.
say_en.note: Claude will call the Hugging Face Space via gradio_client.
